# FMC Media PC 0.3.24

- Leaving the player is instant again: the video pauses at once and the page appears straight away, while the resume point, the Continue Watching picture and the Simkl and home-server reports are saved together in the background. Moving to the next episode no longer waits on them one after another either.
- Settings are grouped by what they are about: Watching (Playback, Subtitles, Downloads), Content (Sources, Home servers, Metadata), Connections and App. Connected accounts shows the FMC account, Stremio, Simkl and Trakt on one page, each with whether it is connected; click one to jump to its settings.
- Full mouse control in the player: right-click the picture for every action (play, skip, audio, subtitles, speed, chapters, episodes, fullscreen, picture-in-picture, diagnostics, download, close); the mouse Back button leaves the player and Forward plays the next episode; Shift + wheel jumps back or forward (the wheel alone stays volume). Settings → Playback → Mouse lists it all.

Includes everything in 0.3.20. Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. Windows x64.
